sinopsis.es: Lucía, de 16 años, es luchadora de lucha libre entrenada desde niña para pelear sucio. Su padre cree que debe ser ruda para triunfar. Debe decidir si confiar en sus propios instintos o seguir las reglas que construyeron a su familia.
sinopsis.en: Sixteen-year-old Lucía is a lucha libre wrestler trained since childhood to fight dirty. Her father believes she must be a ruda to succeed. She must decide whether to trust her own instincts or follow the rules that built her family.
